runtime: node>=22 (host role; not a wasm component)
serves: signed public network records: providers, checker qualifications, owner policies, app routes, host management records

state.what: accepted records and per-app replay floors (route-floors)
state.rebuild: records re-import from peers and re-publication; replay floors must persist (a corrupt store refuses startup, never resets)

cold: two or more Base RPC providers (the operator's quorum), or explicitly this host's local verifier (chainAuthority verifier)
the admin-controlled EnclaveAddressBook address (and optional authority pins)
notCold: peers (optional; a replica starts empty and accepts signed submissions)
